name: docvault-header-cookie-redirect-fix
description: Fix header injection, open redirect, and cookie injection vulnerabilities across a small HTTP document management service with varied code paths, abstraction layers, and data flows spanning multiple modules.
lesson: All 14 mutation faults (0-13) covering header, cookie, and redirect behaviors were killed by the test suite, confirming strong mutation coverage, and 3 of 5 agents passed by correctly implementing the full set of fixes in 6-10 steps. The 2 invalid runs produced no failed tests, meaning the solutions were structurally rejected before evaluation (likely format or file-targeting issues) rather than functionally wrong. The next design should keep the comprehensive mutation-tested rule set but add a clearer solution contract or scaffold to reduce invalid outcomes, and could branch into independent rules on new themes like authentication flows or response caching.
